name: Hotel Auffacherhof
beschreibung: The Hotel Auffacherhof is located in the Auffach district in the municipality of Wildschönau in Tirol. The rooms are furnished in traditional Tyrolean style and often have a balcony with mountain view. The hotel's wellness area includes an indoor pool, a sauna and a steam bath. In the hotel's own restaurant, regional dishes and international dishes are served as part of half board. The alpine surroundings are the starting point for hikes in summer and ski trips in winter. The Schatzbergbahn is in the immediate vicinity and provides direct access to the ski area. Guests can expect a quiet location with direct access to various outdoor activities.
